annotations.title: Get a drug's public cost and coverage figures

description: Gets the public figures for one drug by RxCUI: NADAC, which is what pharmacies pay to buy the drug and not a retail price, Medicare Part D spending, state Medicaid spending by year, and how many marketplace plan drug lists name the drug, with their tiers and limits. None of these figures is what a person pays at the pharmacy. A plan list that does not name the drug is unknown, not a sign that the plan does not cover it.

rxcui.description: The drug's RxNorm concept ID (RxCUI), such as 861004. search_drugs returns it.
